title: Implement an event dispatcher (observer pattern) in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement an EventDispatcher that allows subscribing handlers (closures) to named event types and dispatching events to all registered handlers.

required_artifacts: EventDispatcher stores handlers in HashMap<String, Vec<Box<dyn Fn(&str)>>>
subscribe adds a boxed closure to the event's handler list
dispatch calls all handlers for the named event with the data string
dispatch on unknown event does not panic
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
